title: Testeador AI verdict file (verdicts.json)
description: Versioned record of AI judge verdicts for a scenario's captures. Lives next to the baselines (test_evidence/baseline/<scenario>/verdicts.json) and is committed to git, so every baseline replacement carries its rationale into the PR diff.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this contract. Bump only with a migration note.

capture.description: Run artifact file name the verdict is about (e.g. comprador-03_carrito!!.png).

slug.description: Step slug — keys the baseline file (<actor>-<slug>.png).

verdict.description: fix_code: real regression, the app must change. fix_test: the step's intent or interactions are outdated. replace_baseline: intentional change — the judge copies the new capture over the baseline. inconclusive: a human must decide; escalate, do not act.

rationale.description: Why this verdict, in terms of the step's declared intent and the visible evidence. This is the audit trail reviewed in the PR.

environmentMismatch.description: True when the run's environment (Flutter version / platform) differed from the baseline's canonical environment — drift was discounted accordingly.
